blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—EcoWaste Coalition has urged health product and digital trade regulators to remove online listings of mercury-laced skin lightening products and step up enforcement against their sellers ahead of the 11.11 and 12.12 shopping sales. The group identified Goree Beauty Cream as a priority for enforcement, describing it as the most visible mercury-laden skin-lightening brand on the market and the one most frequently flagged by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). “We are outraged that illegal, high-mercury skin lighteners continue to be smuggled and sold openly all over the country, whether online, on social media, or in physical stores,” said Aileen […]...
